body.x: **Applies to:** Senior and ATL (evaluators); new JNR VIP RTN staff (evaluated)

Used by the Senior and ATL to evaluate new JNR staff at the end of probation. Standard probation is **3 months**. Outcome: **Confirmed Junior**, **Probation Extended** (standard not yet met), or **Not Confirmed**. The fillable scorecard lives in the Probation Evaluation Checklist; this page is the reference.
Source: Senior observation across the probation period. **Pass: all 4.**

head: No.
Criterion
Pass condition
Evidence
rows: Replies within the FRT standard. No unattended chats; no closing without resolution
Tags every chat before closing. No pattern of missing, wrong or double tags
Follows the SOP step by step when guided. No skipped steps or improvising without confirmation
Submits QA Record and Output Report before shift end without repeated reminders

body.x: Source: Mistake Log and Senior observation. **Pass: 3 of 4.**

head: No.
Criterion
Pass condition
Evidence
rows: The same mistake is not repeated more than twice after correction
Asks instead of guessing or proceeding wrongly
Accepts correction without being defensive, and applies it
Measurable improvement from the first month to the last in at least one area (FRT, tagging, submission, SOP accuracy)

body.x: Source: attendance records, Insightful, team observation. **Pass: 3 of 4, and C1 must pass** (failing C1 is an automatic fail).

head: No.
Criterion
Pass condition
Evidence
rows: Consistent attendance. No unexplained absence, repeated late logins or disappearing mid-shift
Tells the team before breaks, updates on task completion, never goes silent on shift
Professional, composed tone. No recorded complaints or attitude issues
Uses VPN and Incognito. Never shares BO, Livechat or system access with unauthorised people

body.x: Any one of these means **Not Confirmed**, whatever the other scores.

head: No.
Condition
Description
Evidence
rows: Issued, or tried to issue, a bonus without Senior or ATL approval
Shared BO, Livechat or any system access with an unauthorised person
Absent without documents or approval more than once during probation
Aggressive, disrespectful or inappropriate conduct toward a customer or colleague, on record

body.x: All sections passed and no automatic fail = **Confirmed Junior VIP RTN**. If the Junior is close but not yet at standard, probation may be extended instead of Not Confirmed.
Who signs: the Senior fills A, B and C; the ATL fills D and makes the decision; the Supervisor gives the overall recommendation.
